div.h1: Pattern B · A2A outbound (remote agent as room member)
div.h3: adapter: a2a — summon over SLIM, call over HTTPS, reply back onto SLIM

text.tspan: The remote never holds a group key (a2a_bridge.py:21-31). The backend seat reads
room plaintext (as moderator/custodian) and calls the remote over plain HTTPS out-of-band.
Auth is a Bearer token whose env-var name lives in the manifest; the secret stays in
